audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 John text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Complete one-chapter draft reviewed for elder/elect lady, truth and love, commandment, discernment, hospitality boundaries.

verses.restored: The elder to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only but also all those knowing the truth,

familiar.text: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

verses.restored: because of the truth remaining in us and being with us into the age.

familiar.text: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

verses.restored: Grace, mercy, peace will be with us from Divine Father and from Jesus Messiah, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

familiar.text: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.restored: I rejoiced greatly because I have found some of your children walking in truth, just as command we received from the Father.

familiar.text: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

verses.restored: And now I ask you, lady, not as writing to you a new command but one we had from beginning: that we love one another.

familiar.text: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

verses.restored: And this is love: that we walk according to his commands. This is the command, just as you heard from beginning, so that you may walk in it.

familiar.text: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

verses.restored: Because many misleading teachers went out into the world-system, those not confessing Jesus Messiah coming in flesh; this is the misleading and opposing-Messiah pattern.

familiar.text: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

verses.restored: Look to yourselves, so that you may not lose what we worked for, but may receive full reward.

familiar.text: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

verses.restored: Everyone going ahead and not remaining in the teaching of Messiah does not have the Divine; the one remaining in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

familiar.text: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

verses.restored: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive this one into house, and do not say to this one greeting.

familiar.text: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

verses.restored: For the one saying greeting to this one participates in that one's harmful works.

familiar.text: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

verses.restored: Having many things to write to you, I did not intend through paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and speak mouth to mouth, so that our joy may be made full.

familiar.text: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

verses.restored: The children of your chosen sister greet you.

familiar.text: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

translation_notes: Chosen lady may be a woman leader/host or a personified assembly; ambiguity is preserved.
Truth and love are inseparable; boundaries in hospitality concern harmful teaching, not fear of outsiders.
Opposing-Messiah language must not be used as paranoia or modern target-mapping.
